assessments.title: Unit 2 synthesis formative check
assessments.instructions: Independently justify four five-point items. 1: Determine whether {(1,4),(2,4),(1,6)} is a function and explain. 2: Evaluate f(−2) for f(x)=x²+3x. 3: A van seats 15 passengers at $8 per passenger. State feasible domain and maximum revenue. 4: Find average rate between (2,10) and (6,26) when x is hours and y is miles.

rubricCriteria.label: Function uniqueness reasoning
rubricCriteria.description: Classification with a valid mapping explanation.

assessments.title: Unit 2 cumulative mastery checkpoint
assessments.instructions: Six independent items, five points each. 1: Is {(−1,3),(0,3),(2,5)} a function? Justify. 2: Evaluate g(−3) for g(x)=2x²−x. 3: State real domain of h(x)=9/(x−6). 4: For table {(0,2),(2,10),(5,22)}, determine whether rate is constant. 5: A reservoir starts at 60 L and drains 4 L/minute. State time domain until empty and evaluate volume at t=7. 6: Explain why an average rate over an interval need not describe every subinterval.

rubricCriteria.label: Interval comparison
rubricCriteria.description: Two calculated rates and consistency conclusion.

rubricCriteria.description: Conceptually correct limitation with example or explanation.
